candidate_selection.current_assignments: provisional baseline only; verify current availability and capabilities before dispatch
per_required_backend: a more capable reasoning configuration appropriate to the role
candidate_selection.constraints: Respect actual account access, privacy policy, capability support and the predeclared experiment budget. Missing access is recorded as untested, never a quality failure or success.

phases: Account/capability preflight and identical small transport probe for every backend; not semantic evaluation
Frozen-input development comparisons by role; expose all existing pilot cases as development
Freeze candidate configs, reference clusters, metrics, matching rules, repetitions and acceptance targets
Run project-held-out comparison without label access; keep inaccessible or unpopulated strata unmeasured
Run bounded end-to-end family comparison to measure discovery and context selection as well as semantic output
experimental_controls: Pin one complete v2 config per cell with DATING_LLM_CONFIG; select backend explicitly, and retain its content digest
Use identical role prompts, schemas and supplied evidence across each controlled comparison
Disable cross-model/backend fallback for isolated quality comparisons; test operational fallback policy in separate cells
Use bounded fail-on-limit policies for evaluation rather than multi-hour subscription waits
Record model/provider availability and capabilities at run time; historical config notes and leaderboard scores are not evidence of dating quality
Separate original response, provider-side transformations when observable, local schema repair and final valid output
Randomize or interleave cell order, repeat to measure instability, and disclose caching/session differences
Keep failed, malformed, truncated, timed-out and abstaining outputs in the denominator; never score only successful responses
required_reporting: Per-backend and per-role attempted/completed/failed counts and reasons, including untested required cells
Source recall, exclusion false negatives, event/role/entity/scenario fidelity, native quantity/statistic/epoch, provenance and abstention
Dependency-cluster uncertainty and model-reference disagreement, with zero severe semantic substitutions in promoted outputs
Requested versus reported model and provider; unknown effective effort/fallback/version remains explicit
Wall time, tokens, repair/retry incidence, known response charges, subscription allowance and nominal estimates separately
Cost and review effort per supported assertion, alongside utility/recall so universal abstention cannot win
Decision to retain, upgrade or route each role, with before/after evidence and unresolved limitations
prohibitions: No backend winner from one transport probe or one overall average
No held-out claims for existing exposed pilot cases
No automatic publication or historical default from model agreement
No missing-cost value converted into known zero expenditure
remaining: Production-schema smoke tests passed after typed native-time repair. Complete-paper extraction, reserved-cluster evaluation and end-to-end family trial remain unmeasured.
